about: Discovery prompts for the Homemove ChatGPT app (OpenAI 'Optimize metadata': direct, indirect and negative prompts). Run each in a fresh ChatGPT conversation with Homemove connected, record the tool called (or none), and compute recall on direct+indirect and precision on negative. Change one metadata field at a time and re-run. Written 21 Oct 2026 for tool metadata v1.0.5.
